regions.today: This evening will be mostly cloudy and dry, with light to moderate southwesterly winds backing southeasterly.
regions.tonight: Remaining cloudy tonight with patches of rain, drizzle and mist. Some hill fog will develop also. Mild and humid with lowest temperatures of 14 to 16 degrees in moderate to fresh southerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be a blustery day with moderate to fresh and gusty southerly winds. Any early morning rain will clear to leave occasional sunny spells at first. However, cloud will increase through the morning with patches of light rain and drizzle spreading from the west through the afternoon and evening. Highest temperatures of 18 to 21 degrees.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate on Saturday. Low to moderate on Sunday
